text.title: Minimum Wage Messiah
text.declared_genre: Alternative Hip-Hop / Acoustic Folk / Spoken Word
text.declared_mood: Witty, wounded, class-conscious, tender → quietly furious, humane, stubbornly hopeful
text.production_notes: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar with percussive busker groove, lo-fi hip-hop drums, brushed snare, palm taps, warm upright bass, sparse piano after second hook, room hiss, live imperfect feel, hard dropouts before punchlines, final third adds soft harmonies while staying raw
text.vocal_notes: Intimate male close-mic vocal, spoken-word rap verses with dry comic timing and clipped pauses, half-sung folk hook, starts observant and sardonic, grows warmer and more direct, slight rasp on punchlines, whispered doubles on key phrases, final hook more melodic and communal
section_names: Intro – spoken | dry, close-mic | sparse guitar
Verse 1 – spoken rap | light guitar groove
Verse 3 – warmer spoken rap | piano enters lightly
Outro – spoken | slight smile | instruments fading

Minimum wage Messiah, with holes in his trainers, turning water into tap water, and still sharing later.
